subject: cult-info-f
title: CULT.INFO.F.------(R)INTR.
description: Chart on book p. 348 (PMBA-12). CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the subject; INTR (interpretation) is the partner, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From PROG-CONT: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: DOC (documentation). From EXP-DY: SG (source initiation). From SG: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From SPT-DY: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: AFI (affinity insight).
